coalitions.name: Immigrant rights
coalitions.description: Groups and actions in Massachusetts standing with immigrant neighbors. This is a sector on the map, not a coalition.

actions.name: Operation Milkweed: give directly to families facing ICE enforcement
actions.description: Direct support for Massachusetts families facing ICE enforcement: choose your city and give to families who need help now.

actions.name: Donate to the Immigrant Solidarity Collective
actions.description: Raises funds to support Western Massachusetts immigrant community members.

actions.name: Donate to the Western Massachusetts Asylum Support Network
actions.description: All donations go directly to people seeking asylum.

events.name: Casting Away Fear, Building Shelter for All
events.description: An afternoon of reflection and spiritual renewal focused on standing with immigrant neighbors: singing, then a short walk to the Mill River for a Tashlich ceremony. Light refreshments; bring something to share if you like.

organizations.name: Jewish Activists for Immigration Justice
organizations.description: Jewish activists in Western Massachusetts standing with their immigrant neighbors.

events.name: Stone Soup Solidarity Workshop Series
events.location: Stone Soup Cafe, 399 Main St, Greenfield, MA
events.description: The Franklin County LUCE hub's workshop series, a good way for new people to get involved. Dinner and childcare provided.

actions.name: Donate to the LUCE ICE hotline
actions.description: Supports the volunteer-staffed hotline that verifies and documents reported ICE activity.

organizations.name: LUCE (Franklin County hub)
organizations.description: Franklin County hub of LUCE, which runs an ICE hotline staffed by volunteers who send verifiers to document reported ICE activity.
